title: Kubernetes Audit：多階段請求關聯與截斷缺口
titleEn: Kubernetes Audit: multistage request correlation and truncation gaps
subcategoryTitle: 多租戶、復原相依與可用性邊界
subcategoryTitleEn: Multitenancy, recovery dependencies and availability boundaries
summary: 以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
summaryEn: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Before labeling Complete-only records as tampering, check whether RequestReceived was omitted by policy. For shortened records, inspect truncation configuration and fields rather than inferring completeness from row count.

steps.objective: 完成「盤點政策與階段」的分辨異常成因，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete discriminate anomaly causes for Inventory policy and stages and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
若Complete-only被直接標成外部竄改，先查是否省略RequestReceived；若事件內容縮小，核對截斷設定與欄位，而非用列數推定完整。
對照「盤點政策與階段」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。針對十個未觀測完成請求建立待查清單，分開政策排除與未知缺口；不將缺失狀態自動映成成功或失敗。
本階段必須重驗：以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
steps.instructionEn:
Before labeling Complete-only records as tampering, check whether RequestReceived was omitted by policy. For shortened records, inspect truncation configuration and fields rather than inferring completeness from row count.
Against the nominal Inventory policy and stages result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Create a follow-up list for the ten identities lacking observed completion. Separate policy exclusions from unexplained gaps, and never map absent status automatically to either success or failure.
Reverify this criterion: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。若Complete-only被直接標成外部竄改，先查是否省略RequestReceived；若事件內容縮小，核對截斷設定與欄位，而非用列數推定完整。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Before labeling Complete-only records as tampering, check whether RequestReceived was omitted by policy. For shortened records, inspect truncation configuration and fields rather than inferring completeness from row count.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
steps.checkEn: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 稽核匯出包含同一請求的多個階段，告警卻將每列當成一次API呼叫；另有未完成與被省略階段，使成功率和覆蓋率混在一起。
knowledge.textEn: An audit export contains several stages of the same request, but a dashboard treats every row as an API call. Incomplete and omitted stages further confuse operation success with logging coverage.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: Kubernetes稽核政策可選事件層級及省略階段；缺少ResponseComplete不能單獨證明請求失敗，也可能是政策、長連線或收集缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Kubernetes audit policy selects levels and may omit stages. A missing ResponseComplete record alone does not prove request failure; policy choices, long-running requests and collection gaps are alternative explanations.

quiz.questionEn: Inventory policy and stages: Which statement gives the evidence-based disposition or re-verification condition?

quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「處置與重新驗證」。針對十個未觀測完成請求建立待查清單，分開政策排除與未知缺口；不將缺失狀態自動映成成功或失敗。 與本階段判準一起判讀：以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies disposition and re-verification. Create a follow-up list for the ten identities lacking observed completion. Separate policy exclusions from unexplained gaps, and never map absent status automatically to either success or failure. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.

steps.title: 盤點政策與階段 · 驗收並留下交接件
steps.titleEn: Inventory policy and stages · Accept and hand over evidence
steps.objective: 完成「盤點政策與階段」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Inventory policy and stages and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
提交audit-fixture.jsonl、request-lifecycle.csv、policy-manifest.json及missing-stage.md；摘要應分列身份數、階段數和狀態覆蓋。
在交接件中加入「盤點政策與階段」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver audit-fixture.jsonl, request-lifecycle.csv, policy-manifest.json and missing-stage.md. The summary must distinguish identities, stage rows and response-status coverage so later reviewers cannot confuse their denominators.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Inventory policy and stages: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

stages.title: 盤點政策與階段
stages.description: 稽核匯出包含同一請求的多個階段，告警卻將每列當成一次API呼叫；另有未完成與被省略階段，使成功率和覆蓋率混在一起。 以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 以100個auditID建立明確配對清單；同請求階段重送時保留傳輸嘗試但不要新增請求。加入不同auditID但相同requestURI的案例，確認不以URL全文去重而合併真正兩次呼叫。
stages.descriptionEn: An audit export contains several stages of the same request, but a dashboard treats every row as an API call. Incomplete and omitted stages further confuse operation success with logging coverage. Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Enumerate all hundred audit IDs and stage pairs explicitly. Replaying one request stage may add a transport attempt but must not create another request identity. Include identical requestURI values under different audit IDs and verify URL-text deduplication does not collapse genuinely separate API operations.
